description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L311-368: 5 tests for '\ followed by Enter inserts newline (not submit)' — upstream Editor's workaround for terminals that cannot emit Shift+Enter. Elixir uses Shift+Enter for newline directly; this workaround is intentionally not ported. Action: document the divergence in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input moduledoc and close this child without adding tests. No re-comparison needed (the semantics differ by design).

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Backslash+Enter newline workaround" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Backslash+Enter newline workaround" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Backslash+Enter newline workaround" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Intentional divergence, previously recorded in opi-q5k.5 audit. We use Shift+Enter for newline and plain Enter for submit, matching our Input component's existing behavior; backslash+Enter is not interpreted as a newline workaround. No tests ported.
